analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 26.9 entering extreme oversold territory, CCI at -215.1 attempting a bounce after a sharp decline. 4-hour RSI at 25.1 also in oversold territory. Weekly ADX at 14.4 indicates a non-trending phase, but daily oversold indicators suggest a potential bounce. The 5-day low of $647.05 was renewed, maintaining the downtrend, but extreme oversold indicators hint at a short-term rebound.
